title: Built on the shoulders of giants — Pagayo
description: Pagayo is built on a handful of extraordinary platforms: Cloudflare, Stripe, GitHub, OpenAI, Cursor, and Claude. Here is what each of them does — and why we picked them.

hero.badge: With gratitude to the people behind the platforms
hero.intro: Pagayo is focused. The platforms it stands on are vast. Six extraordinary tools — built by thousands of people over many years — make everything we do possible. Here they are, and here is why we picked each one.

giants.name: Cloudflare
giants.body: Every page, every API call, every database query, every payment webhook — they all run on Cloudflare's global edge network. Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues, Workflows, Pages, DNS, Access, WAF. The entire Pagayo platform lives here.
bullets: No origin servers, no maintenance windows
D1, KV, R2 — storage where the request lands

giants.name: Stripe
giants.tagline: The part that absolutely must be right.
giants.body: Stripe handles the money. Cards, iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA, Apple Pay, Google Pay, subscriptions, refunds, invoices, payouts, tax. Pagayo speaks one clean API and the rest is taken care of — every single time.
bullets: Every major payment method, one integration
PCI compliance without lifting a finger

giants.name: GitHub
giants.tagline: Nothing ships without a green check.
giants.body: Every line of Pagayo lives on GitHub. Pull requests, Actions, releases, packages, secrets, environments — the whole build-and-ship pipeline runs there. Every deployment starts with a commit, and ends with a green check. Nothing ever bypasses it.
bullets: Every change reviewed in a pull request
Staging and production deploys via Actions

giants.name: OpenAI
giants.tagline: The quiet intelligence behind easy features.
giants.body: OpenAI powers the parts of Pagayo that need to think — admin assistants, product help, content understanding, search relevance. The features that just feel easier than they should. The models keep getting better; Pagayo gets better with them.
bullets: Admin assistants that understand your shop
New capabilities ride in on every model release

giants.name: Cursor
giants.tagline: A single operator, moving like a team.
giants.body: Pagayo is built inside Cursor. It's where code is written, refactored, reviewed, and shipped. Multi-agent workflows, deep codebase context, instant edits across repos — Cursor is what turns a single operator into a development team that can move at the speed of the platform itself.
bullets: Multi-repo context across the whole platform
From idea to deploy in the same window

giants.name: Claude
giants.tagline: The engineer in the chair next to mine.
giants.body: Claude reads the codebase, weighs trade-offs, writes careful changes, catches the bugs I would have shipped, and explains its reasoning along the way. Most of what gets built at Pagayo is built in conversation with Claude — and the platform is sharper for it.
bullets: Reasons out loud — no black-box edits

closing.sectionLabel: A focused platform, a big thank-you
closing.headline: Standing on, not standing in for.
paragraphs: Pagayo is not a thin wrapper over any of these tools. It is its own platform — its own data model, its own architecture, its own opinions about how commerce should work. But it would be foolish to pretend we built any of this alone.
To every engineer at Cloudflare, Stripe, GitHub, OpenAI, Cursor, and Anthropic: thank you. Pagayo exists because your work exists.
